scoring_justification: Phase transition pressure is recomputed from the agent's own enthalpy curves (T1). Elastic constants and thermodynamic properties are compared to paper-reported values with generous tolerances, supported by structural trend checks for thermodynamic curves (T0/T3).

hidden_assets.purpose: Hidden gold for phase transition pressure (52.8 GPa)
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Section 3.1: 'the phase transition from NbO-type to NiAs-type occurs at ca. 52.8 GPa'.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted directly from the paper's reported value.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: This is the exact value reported by the authors; used as a tolerance target.

hidden_assets.purpose: Hidden gold for elastic constants, moduli, and Vickers hardness (NbO and NiAs).
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Table 3, columns C11-C44 and derived moduli and Vickers hardness.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted directly from the paper's Table 3.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the paper's own computed results; used as reference for tolerance comparison.

hidden_assets.purpose: Hidden gold for Debye temperature (525 K) and Dulong-Petit limit (49.9 J/mol/K).
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Section 3.5: 'calculated Debye temperature ΘD for NbO-ReN is 525 K'; Dulong-Petit limit 3nR with n=2 atoms, R=8.314462618 => ~49.9 J/mol/K.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted directly from paper text and standard physical constant.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Debye temperature is the paper's reported value; Dulong-Petit limit is a well-known classical limit used to sanity-check computed heat capacities.

required.NbO_enthalpy: array of {P: float (GPa), H: float (eV or arbitrary unit)}
required.NiAs_enthalpy: array of {P: float (GPa), H: float (same unit as NbO)}

outputs.description: The transition pressure from the crossing of NbO and NiAs enthalpy curves, verified against the paper-reported value within tolerance.

required.NbO: object with fields C11, C12, C44, bulk_modulus, shear_modulus, youngs_modulus, poissons_ratio, Vickers_hardness (all floats, elastic moduli in GPa, hardness in GPa)
required.NiAs: object with fields C11, C33, C44, C12, C13, bulk_modulus, shear_modulus, youngs_modulus, poissons_ratio, Vickers_hardness (all floats, elastic moduli in GPa, hardness in GPa)

outputs.description: Elastic constants and derived mechanical properties for both phases at zero pressure, compared to the paper's reported values with tolerances.

required.Debye_temperature_NbO_K: float (Debye temperature in K at 0 GPa)
required.thermal_expansion_0GPa: array of {T: float (K), alpha: float (10^-5 K^-1 or arbitrary)}

outputs.description: Debye temperature compared to paper reference; Cv and α curves checked for correct qualitative trends (Dulong-Petit limit, pressure dependence).

output_contract.notes: The agent must use open-source DFT and the quasi-harmonic Debye model; the paper's VASP results are not required. All artifacts are human-readable and re-derivable from the raw data the agent computes. No paper identity or gold values are exposed.

steps.description: Recompute crossing pressure from enthalpy curves and compare to paper's 52.8 GPa within ±5 GPa tolerance.
Compare elastic constants and derived moduli to paper Table 3 with relative tolerances; verify NiAs mechanical stability.
Check Debye temperature within 10% of 525 K, Cv approaches Dulong-Petit limit and decreases with pressure, alpha shows expected temperature and pressure dependencies.
